address: 16 Hoe Nhai Street, Nguyen Trung Truc Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, 11115, Vietnam
bio: The chef crafts delectable bánh cuốn, Vietnamese steamed rolls with minced pork and black fungus. She also serves an option with a soft poached egg. Order the pork meatloaf and sausage, and season with fresh herbs, chilli, lime or garlic at will for a great breakfast or snack....
